text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PDINC-84721 — gpu-alloc-failure (gpu-pool-west2a) — severity: P1 — 35% error rate on inference-route /v1/generate
samir: acked oncall. I'll take first look. pinging @maria for infra help
maria: on it, looking at pool metrics now. seeing sustained GPU mem usage ~98% across 6 nodes
ops-bot: automated action: disabled preemptible batch jobs in pool "gpu-batch-west2a" (ids: batch-***/***)
samir: thanks. samir here — quick checklist: nv-smi, pod list, recent deploys
jin: I'm also available if we need cross-region failover
samir: running: kubectl -n infra get pods -l pool=gpu-west2a -o wide
samir: results snip: pod/gpu-inf-001 Running  OOMKilled  0  2m  node/gpu-122  ip  nvidia.com/gpu=1
samir: ssh to node gpu-122; ran nvidia-smi
samir: nvidia-smi output: 
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
| 0    A100-80GB    On           | 00000000:65:00.0  | N/A                 |
| | Fan  Temp  Perf  Pwr:Usage/Cap|
| | 30%  78C    P2    250W/300W    |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes: | GPU Memory |
| pid 1020: inference-server  78GB / 80GB |
```
maria: looks like several long-running sessions held KV cache and not releasing. kvcache eviction not keeping up
samir: logs from inference-server show repeated "CUDA OOM when allocating 2048 MiB" + retry loop
samir: immediate mitigation options: 1) force-kill longest-running sessions, 2) scale up pool (add nodes), 3) enable CPU fallback for low-priority classes
maria: scaling is slow right now due to quota; I'm requesting burst-add of 4 GPUs from cloud (support ticket filed)
ops-bot: auto-shedder: starting passive eviction of idle sessions older than 5m in pool gpu-west2a
samir: I'm going to evict top 3 pids holding most memory now (non-customer-interactive batch jobs first)
samir: command: kubectl exec -n infra pod/gpu-inf-001 -- pkill -f batch_worker || true
maria: confirmed evictions freed ~30GB across nodes, memory pressure reduced to ~85%
customer-success-bot: alert: 3 tenants reporting increased error rates (tenant-omega, tenant-lumen, tenant-beta). CS on call notified
samir: ETA on adding nodes? maria?
maria: cloud support replied: approving burst capacity, nodes should register in ~7-10m
jin: in parallel we should route high-priority traffic to west2b (healthy) and apply rate-limiting to non-critical customers
samir: initiating graceful route change: updating router policy to prefer gpu-west2b for model-llama-13b for 95% traffic
ops-bot: router: policy update applied — traffic shift started, draining connections from gpu-west2a
samir: quick sanity: rates to west2a dropping, error rate to 6% and falling
maria: watch: a node had a stuck CUDA context preventing mem reclaim; doing kube restart of pod/gpu-inf-004
samir: performed restart, pod came up, memory usage stabilized
customer-success-bot: CS update: tenant-omega reports partial recovery, we've posted incident notice. CS to follow up with postmortem request
jin: is there a suspected root cause? kvcache leak after a recent model upgrade? any suspicious deploys last hour?
maria: I see a Canary roll for model-llama-13b-quant went out ~55m ago to west2a and batch sessions spiked
samir: filing hypothesis: model change introduced heavier KV usage per session leading to fragmentation; combined with long-lived sessions blocked evictions -> OOM cascade
samir: tagging this incident: kvcache-frag + model-canary
maria: recommended next steps: rollback canary in west2a, add guardrails: max-kv-per-session, enforce kvcache LRU eviction patch
samir: rolling back canary now: kubectl -n models rollout undo deployment/llama-13b-canary
ops-bot: rollout undo accepted; monitoring for regressions
samir: handoff plan: I'm keeping eyes for 20m, then handing to @jin for follow-up and RCA since she owns kv/eviction work
jin: ack — will take postmortem ownership. I'll collect logs, quota tickets, and timeline
samir: customers impacted list: tenant-omega (high), tenant-lumen (medium), tenant-beta (low). CS notified and triage ongoing
maria: cloud nodes are coming online now, autoscaler added 3 nodes — pool healthy at 60% mem
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PDINC-84721 acknowledged by samir at 4422227777; status: mitigated; not resolved
samir: closing active page, leaving follow-up tasks in #eng-sre (RCA, postmortem, rollback impact), assign to jin for next 24h
jin: will create RCA doc and link to this thread. thanks all, good triage :thumbsup:
ops-bot: automated summary: Evicted idle batch sessions, rolled back model canary, scaled pool + traffic reroute. Customer impact limited to 3 tenants; remediation done. Next: RCA + kvcache LRU deploy
samir: switching pager to monitoring silent watch. if error rate > 3% will re-alert. ending handoff.
